name: process
summary: Fixed-output deterministic fixture: process one starter note into deterministic structured metadata.
description: Reference app capability for downstream Traverse app authors that proves a real contract, WASM package, app manifest, workflow, and runtime request without depending on model inference. IMPORTANT: this artifact is a fixed-output deterministic fixture -- it does not read or process its input at all; it always returns the same hardcoded title/tags/noteType/suggestedNextAction/status values regardless of the note provided. It is a genuine, real WASI binary (not a placeholder stub sharing a digest with unrelated capabilities), useful for proving the registry/artifact-hosting/execution pipeline end-to-end, but it does not perform real analysis on its input. Tracked follow-up for real per-input logic: registry#79.

preconditions.description: The caller provides a non-empty note string.

postconditions.description: The capability returns a fixed title/tags/noteType/suggestedNextAction/status value, identical for every call regardless of the note provided.

side_effects.description: Produces deterministic note metadata from the provided input.
